name: TJ-Plugins
description: TJ-Plugins providers for Nuvio — Hindi, dubbed, Bollywood and world movies & series.
author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: AniHype
scrapers.description: AniHype (anihype.sbs) anime servers: TryEmbed Japanese+English Sub and English Dub (1080p), Katana Sub (1080p), Uqload (Japanese + English audio), Orion (Japanese, English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, French; HEVC) and Mikaza Hindi Dub, with English subtitles. TMDB titles are mapped to the right AniList season; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: Bingr
scrapers.description: Bingr (bingr.one) servers: Prism multi-audio (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, English, French and more) up to 1080p, Edge, Nimbus and Citadel (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada dubs), with subtitles. Hindi first; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: CineHD
scrapers.description: CineHD (cinehd.vc) — movies & series from a TMDB catalog with many servers per title (MhPly/AwsPly Hindi, Nitro multi-audio, HDHub, Rock HLS, MovieBox, VidAPI…). Every link is checked before it is shown; Hindi first.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: CineJoy
scrapers.description: CineJoy (cinejoy.pk) — movies & series from a TMDB catalog (Netflix/Prime rows) with many servers per title: Nitro multi-audio, MhPly/AwsPly Hindi, HDHub, VidAPI, MovieBox, Rock HLS. Links are checked before they are shown.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: Cinezo
scrapers.description: Cinezo (cinezo.gd) VidNest + ScreenScape servers: Hindi dubs, multi-audio and English up to 4K, with subtitles. Hindi first; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: DesiDubAnime
scrapers.description: Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and multi-audio dubbed anime series and movies (Naruto, Demon Slayer, Attack on Titan, Jujutsu Kaisen and more), HLS with English subtitles. Each site season is matched to its TMDB season.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: FMovies
scrapers.description: FMoviess (fmoviess.tv) — HD movies & TV shows with Trending / Latest rows. MoviesAPI multi-quality HLS with subtitles, plus a VidAPI/MovieBox backup for titles MoviesAPI lacks (and VixSrc where reachable). Every link is checked before it is shown.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: HiCine
scrapers.description: HiCine (hicine.sbs): Hollywood, Bollywood, K-Drama and anime movies and series, dual audio Hindi, up to 1080p from FSL, PixelDrain and other direct servers; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: HiStream
scrapers.description: HiStream (histream.lol) player servers: Hindi first, then English, Tamil and Telugu; Bollywood, Hindi series and platform originals. Every link is checked before it is shown.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: KatDrama
scrapers.description: KatDrama (new.katdrama.my): Korean and Chinese dramas and movies in Hindi, dual audio and English, from HubCloud and StreamTape (480p-1080p); every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: KatMovieHD
scrapers.description: KatMovieHD — Hollywood & web series in Hindi dubbed / dual audio. Movies in every posted quality (StreamTape, HubCloud, GDFlix Instant / Drive), series with full episode lists and other seasons merged in. Links are checked before they are shown.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: KDMaza
scrapers.description: KDMaza (kdramasmaza.net): Korean, Chinese and Turkish dramas, Korean movies and anime in Hindi/Urdu, from HubCloud and GDFlix; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: KMMovies
scrapers.description: KMMovies (kmmovies.beer, new home of Khatrimaza): Bollywood, Hollywood, South, Hindi dubbed and dual-audio movies. Direct KMCLOUD files (R2 and Google Drive) up to 1080p, checked before they are shown.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: MoviesHubHD
scrapers.description: MoviesHubHD (movieshubhd.com) player network: Hindi + English tracks, multi-audio, up to 4K, with subtitles where available. Hindi first; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: Net77
scrapers.description: Net77 (net77.cc, the original NetMirror): Netflix, Prime Video and JioHotstar titles in every audio language they have (Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Korean, Japanese...), 1080p HLS with English subtitles.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: Nxsha
scrapers.description: Nxsha (nxsha.space): the site's own rows and search, with its multi-server links (Nitro, Citadel, Prism, HubCloud, 4K-Hub, mahalala, CastVid…) in every audio track they offer
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: PikaHD
scrapers.description: PikaHD (new.pikahd.co): anime series and movies in Hindi, English and Japanese (dual audio), from HubCloud, GDFlix and StreamTape up to 1080p; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: RareAnimes
scrapers.description: RareAnimes / Rare Toons India (rareanimes.mov): Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam dubbed anime, cartoons and animated movies. Every audio language of an episode is listed, played as direct HD files from the site's StreamBeta servers; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: RiveStream
scrapers.description: RiveStream (rivestream.ru) - TMDB-powered catalog of movies and TV shows, streamed from rivestream's server backends (Citadel, Prvibd, River, Kutti, Gbru, HindiSk) plus MhPly, AwsPly, VidPi and HDHub as fallbacks. Hindi audio is listed first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: ScreenScape
scrapers.description: ScreenScape (screenscape.me) Scape servers: 30+ servers per title (Hindi dubs, Nitro multi-audio, Citadel, 4K-Hub…). Hindi first; every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: SSR Movies
scrapers.description: SSR Movies (ssrmovies.surf) - Hindi dubbed and dual audio movies, Bollywood, Hollywood, web series, TV and WWE shows in 480p to 4K. Daily shows list every episode by date. Streams come from Watch (HLS), HubCloud, GDFlix and Direct-Cloud mirrors resolved to direct files.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: SubDubAnime
scrapers.description: SubDubAnime (subdubanime.site): Hindi and English dubbed (and subbed) anime series and movies, up to 1080p. Every language version of a title is listed (Hindi Dubbed, Hindi Fan Dubbed, English Dubbed...); every link is checked.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: Vidbox
scrapers.description: Vidbox (vidbox.vc) - TMDB catalog of movies and TV shows with Nxsha multi-language servers. Hindi audio first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali. Every link is checked before it is shown.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: Zenix
scrapers.description: Zenix (zenix.website): its own home rows and search, playing the site player's Orion links in every audio track offered (Original, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, French, Spanish…) up to 1080p
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins

scrapers.name: ZXCStream
scrapers.description: ZXCStream (zxcstream.com) Main Server (vidstuck): Orion (original audio + Hindi dub, up to 1080p), Daedalus and Atlas, with subtitles. Kept under the server's rate limit so the links play.
scrapers.author: TJ-Plugins
